// REQ: LANG-2441 LANG-2442 LANG-2443 LANG-2444
$version: "2"
namespace example.greeter
/// Greeter service
service Greeter { version: "2024-01-01", operations: [Greet] }
@readonly
@http(method: "GET", uri: "/greet/{name}")
operation Greet {
    input := { @required @httpLabel name: String }
    output := { message: String }
}
